svg.title: MuJoCo Puzzle Gym
svg.desc: Pixel-art night scene: a small duck robot walks across a walled room onto a yellow floor switch; the switch turns green, a signal line lights up from the switch to the wooden gate in the dividing wall and the gate rises. The duck walks through to the blue goal pad, sparkles pop and CLEAR! appears. The portfolio owner stands outside on the left; Claude in headphones cheers on the right.
